name: horos
description: Classify a repository's token sinks with evidence and emit the reading boundary agents respect.

interface.shortDescription: Classify a repository's token sinks with evidence and emit the reading boundary agents respect.
interface.longDescription: Walks a repository, classifies generated files, vendored trees, lockfiles, minified bundles and single-line blobs with the evidence that earned each entry, writes a deterministic committed boundary, verifies it against the tree, and prints Python skeleton maps for oriented reading.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use horos to scan this repository and emit the reading boundary.
